description: Used by the SlabLineage photo panel: saves a photo the user took as the listing photo of a Deal Desk purchase. side front replaces the front photo (a back photo already saved is kept); side back adds a back photo after the current front photo.

dealId.description: The dealId from record_purchase or prepare_listing.

imageBase64.description: The photo as base64 data (7 MB at most).

side.description: front or back of the card.

name: attach_deal_photo
title: Add a listing photo
